Crochet Balloon Dog Pattern is HERE! 🐶🎈 Thank you all so much for your patience — this one took a while to perfect, and I’m so excited to finally share it with you! HOW IT WORKS You’ll crochet the pieces, shape each one over a latex balloon with fabric stiffener, sew them together and reinforce the joints with fabric stiffener again. The full process — shaping, stiffening & assembly — is shown in a video tutorial included with the pattern. WHAT’S INCLUDED ✔ Step-by-step written instructions ✔ Stitch charts ✔ Video tutorial (shaping, stiffening & assembly) ✔ Materials list + fabric stiffener recommendations & alternatives SKILLS NEEDED 🧶 Crochet — Confident Beginner / Intermediate 🪡 Sewing — Basic 🎈 Balloon twisting — no prior experience needed, a short YT tutorial beforehand is enough! Written in English | US crochet terminology  🎉 To celebrate the launch, the pattern is available at a special discount for a limited time! #crochetballoondog #crochetpattern #pollyseiacrochetballoons #crochetballoon #crochetpatternrelease
